entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for calling VeloFit, you're speaking with Alex. How can I help you today?
Hi, I need to return an item. Order number is VF982451.
Okay, I can certainly help with that. To get started, what specifically is the issue with the item?

They're the cycling shoes I bought. I tried everything, adjusting the cleats, different socks, you name it. They're just giving me terrible blisters. I just need to start the refund process, I don't have much time.
I understand completely, no problem. Let me pull up that order, VF982451. Okay, I see the Pro-Carbon cycling shoes, delivered 14 days ago. That's well within our 90-day return window.
So, it's approved for a full refund?

Yes, absolutely. I've just processed the return authorization and sent a prepaid shipping label to the email on file. Just package the shoes up, attach the label, and you can drop them off. Once we receive them, the refund will be issued.
Got the email. That's all I needed. Thanks.
You're very welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great rest of your day.
